contentText: After a week of twists and turns, US President Donald Trump delivered a highly anticipated speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos on Wednesday. Earlier at Davos, French President Emmanuel Macron decried bullying on the global stage and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney warned that "the old order is not coming back". For analysis, FRANCE 24's Charles Pellegrin talks to Brett Bruen, president and CEO of the Global Situation Room, who is just back from Davos.
